intro: Nepal has about 30 million people from over 100 ethnic and caste groups, speaking more than 120 languages.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: Nepali is the official language. Groups include Chhetri, Brahmin, Magar, Tharu, Tamang, Newar and Sherpa. Most people are Hindu, with a large Buddhist minority.
Millions of Nepalis work abroad in the Gulf, Malaysia and India.

chapters.title: Life
text: Most people live in villages and farm. Kathmandu is the largest city.

keyTerms.meaning: A mountain people famous as Himalayan guides.
